en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a grand building with classical architecture, most likely a palace or manor. The building sits on a terrace above a stone wall, with steps leading up to it and a bridge extending over a body of water. Trees and well-trimmed round bushes are visible around the property. There are swans on the water, lending a tranquil air to the scene. The front bears the words 'Bad Pyrmont. Schloss.' In the back, it contains printed and stamped text in German, with mentions of 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
